messages.content: I forgot all the API tokens, can you remind me of them? My user ID is 123456789.

function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_get_shareable_api_tokens
function.description: Retrieve a list of shareable API tokens associated with the user's account. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user whose API tokens are to be retrieved.

include_revoked.description: A flag to determine whether to include revoked tokens in the list.

function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_get_api_tokens
function.description: Retrieve a list of API tokens associated with the user's account. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_expired.description: Whether to include expired tokens in the response.

page.description: The page number of the token list to retrieve, starting from 1.

page_size.description: The number of tokens to retrieve per page. Maximum is 100.

function.name: api_token_api_APITokenApi_post_api_token
function.description: Generate a new API token to authenticate and authorize subsequent API calls. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: The username associated with the account for which the API token is to be created.

password.description: The password corresponding to the username for authentication.

token_name.description: A descriptive name for the token being created.

expiry_date.description: The expiration date for the token in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. If not provided, the token will have a default expiry of one year from creation.

permissions.description: The level of access the token provides, such as 'read', 'write', 'admin'.

message.reasoning: The user wants to retrieve all API tokens. We have two functions: CustomDashboardsApi_get_shareable_api_tokens and api_token_api_APITokenApi_get_api_tokens. The first retrieves shareable API tokens; the second retrieves API tokens. The user says they forgot all API tokens. They want to retrieve them. We need to call the appropriate function. Which function should we use? The user didn't specify if they want shareable tokens or all tokens. The question: "I forgot all the API tokens, can you remind me of them?" That implies retrieving all tokens. So we should call api_token_api_APITokenApi_get_api_tokens. But we might also consider calling CustomDashboardsApi_get_shareable_api_tokens. The user gave user ID. The first function requires user_id. The second does not require user_id. The second returns all tokens for the authenticated user. The user presumably has an authenticated session. The user ID is given but not needed for the second function. The second function includes optional include_expired. The user didn't mention including expired. So we can call it with default parameters. Let's call api_token_api_APITokenApi_get_api_tokens with no arguments. That will return the first page of tokens. But we might need to handle pagination. The user might have many tokens. We could ask them how many tokens they have. But we can just call with page=1, page_size=100. That will get up to 100 tokens. If more than 100, we might need to paginate. But we can just call with page_size=100. The function signature: include_expired?: boolean, page?: number, page_size?: number. We'll call with page=1, page_size=100. That will return up to 100 tokens. If there are more, we might need to ask them. But let's just call it.
